name_input: AMERICAN PRECOAT SPECIALITY PRIVATE LIMITED; AMERICAN PRECOAT SPECIALITY PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey buyer list shows only 7 shipments attributed to "M/S ASTRA NOVA LLP" (56A, SQ 78, KABANBAI BATYR AVENUE, YESIL DISTRICT, ASTANA, KAZAKHSTAN) with AMERICAN PRECOAT SPECIALITY PRIVATE LIMITED as counterparty — no date, HS code or B/L number is displayed for that lane, so no dated export record could be quoted. Source counter: ImportKey page states "Total Shipments 196 Records detected" and "Trading Partners 7 Known counterparties"; rows actually visible on the free page = 5 import rows (all inbound to India) + 3 buyer rows, i.e. 8 rows seen vs 196 claimed.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract record could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403, eximpedia.app and volza.com returned HTTP 403, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) for the whole session. No domestic supply line can be quoted.
note: All 5 dated customs rows visible on ImportKey are IMPORTS into India, not exports: e.g. "2026-02-12 | JIANGSU SANMU GROUP CO LTD | AMERICAN PRECOAT SPECIALITY PRIVATE LIMITED | AMINO RESIN SM5747 | Shanghai, CHINA | HAZIRA PORT SURAT INHZA1, India | 39092090 | BOL 7469923" and "2026-02-11 | Suzhou Whitearrow Titanium Industry Co.,ltd. | ... RUTILE TITANIUM DIOXIDE R987T | 32061110 | BOL 7461027". The company is therefore demonstrably an active buyer/importer of coating raw materials (amino resin, TiO2, rheology additive) with real dated customs entries, but no dated export bill of lading was found. Declared HS 390690 (acrylic polymers) does not match any observed line: visible import HS codes are 39092090 (amino resins), 32061110 (TiO2 pigment) and 34049090 — per project rule the HS is to be corrected to the factual codes, not used as a rejection ground. Registered address on the customs record is A-15, Flatted Factory Complex, Okhla Phase-II (Delhi), which conflicts with the claimed state Uttar Pradesh — flag for address verification, not a rejection ground. PAN AAICS7859L not independently verified (registry pages blocked). No export shipment with date/destination/HS/B-L could be confirmed; no domestic supply traces found in accessible sources. Verdict: keep in base, export_status declared_only, domestic_status unknown — evidence insufficient, not a rejection.
